definitions.explanation: Performing a play, musical, or other stage production again after its original run has ended. Can also refer to re-performing a piece of music or replaying a role.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧ミュージカル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{再演|さいえん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The popular musical will have a revival performance.

examples.japanese: {初演|しょえん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再演|さいえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決定|けってい}した→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: A revival has been announced for the first time in ten years since the premiere.

examples.japanese: ⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{熱望|ねつぼう}→熱望：18643_netsubou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|こた}え→応える：09893_kotaeru⟧、⟦{演出|えんしゅつ}→演出：04460_enshutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一新|いっしん}→一新：19941_isshin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{再演|さいえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来春|らいしゅん}→来春：27524_raishun⟧⟦{上演|じょうえん}→上演：11297_jouen⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: In response to the fans' passionate requests, a restaging with a fresh direction is scheduled for next spring.

notes:
USAGE:
{再演|さいえん} is a performing arts term used for stage productions (plays, musicals, operas) that are performed again. It can be used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. The antonym of sorts is {初演|しょえん} (premiere).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再演|さいえん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to revive, to restage)
- {再演|さいえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決定|けってい}する→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧ (a revival is decided)
- {再演|さいえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{望|のぞ}む→望む：01976_nozomu⟧ (to hope for a revival)
- {再演|さいえん}⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧ (revival performance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {再演|さいえん}: revival performance (same production staged again)
- {初演|しょえん}: premiere (first performance)
- ⟦{再放送|さいほうそう}→再放送：08173_saihousou⟧: rebroadcast, rerun (for TV/radio)
- {再上映|さいじょうえい}: re-screening (for films)
